# Portable package evaluation department

Load `AGENTS.md`, `docs/VALIDATION.md`, the package-eval plan, and the relevant browser/benchmark contracts before changing behavior.

Preserve exact package identity, clean-room isolation, paired-treatment invariants, deterministic grader evidence, product-surface state, and explicit `NOT_EXECUTED` status until a real evaluator runs.

Package evaluation never grants release, canon, merge, browser, credential, or authority promotion. Human takeover may satisfy authentication or CAPTCHA boundaries, but secret input remains model-invisible and a resumed browser must be reverified before automation continues.
